attchmntText: Nagreeka Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Nagreeka Exports Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of its Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The results were published in The Echo of India and Arthik Lipi on 08.11.2026. Akshya Vyapar Limited filed a notice regarding its Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30.09.2026. IDBI Bank Ltd. issued a possession notice for immovable property belonging to Mrs. Purnima Giri and others, with an outstanding amount of Rs.66,66,545.00 as on 09.07.2026. Possession was taken on 05.11.2026. State Bank of India issued a possession notice for a residential flat belonging to Mr. Chittaranjan Manna, with an outstanding amount of Rs.15,23,909.00 as on 17.08.2026. Possession was taken on 03.11.2026.

attchmntText: Nagreeka Exports Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Nagreeka Exports Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 7th November 2026. The Board approved the Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Limited Review Report was issued by M/s B. Nath & Co., Chartered Accountants. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 32,825.83 lakhs. Net profit for the period was 238.84 lakhs. Earnings per share was 0.76. Total assets stood at 42,185.36 lakhs. Long-term borrowings increased to 6,320.11 lakhs. Short-term borrowings were 14,393.60 lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents decreased to 68.94 lakhs. The meeting commenced at 01:00 P.M. and concluded at 03:30 P.M. Sushil Patwari, Chairman, signed the disclosure.
